You are implementing Task 7: the Recruiter Job List page.

## Task Description

Read your task brief first: `/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-20-pan-african-org-site-and-video/task-7-brief.md`

It contains the full task text, the complete test cases to append verbatim, and the required page structure.

## Context

Work from: `/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype` (branch `feat/pan-african-org`)

`pan-african-org/en/` now holds 12 English pages for a demo aimed at **pan-African membership organizations**. The org is `Pan-African Enterprise Alliance`. Eleven are the organization's own admin console; the twelfth, `seeker-home.html` (Task 6), is the job seeker's view.

This task adds the last page: the **recruiter's** view — what a person at a *member company* sees when managing their jobs. It later becomes beat 03 of a tutorial video, whose story is "member companies get recruitment software at no cost".

It is a third distinct shell: entity-scoped admin, not organization-wide admin and not the seeker feed.

### The real product, which I observed logged in (you cannot see it)

I inspected the live demo's entity-admin job list. Its structure:

- **Left nav:** the entity's name with `Entity Admin` beneath it as a subtitle, then Home, Inbox, Manage Entity, Users & Roles, Jobs (Jobs active).
- **Header row:** an `Overview` heading at left, a `+ Post a Job` primary button at right.
- **Status tabs with counts, in this order:** `Overview(n)`, `Active(n)`, `Draft(n)`, `Closed(n)`, `Expired(n)`, `Trash(n)`, `All(n)`.
- **Four KPI tiles across one row:** `ACTIVE JOBS`, `APPLICANTS AWAITING REVIEW`, `UPCOMING PRE-SCREENING CALLS`, `INTERVIEW RESPONSES AWAITING REVIEW`, each a big number.
- **Two chart panels side by side:**
  - `JOB APPLICATIONS` — a `TOTAL` figure, range chips `24H / 7D / 30D / 90D / 365D` with one selected, and a bar series with dates along the x-axis.
  - `APPLICANTS BY RECRUITMENT STAGES` — a `TOTAL` figure, range chips `Today / This Week / This Month / This Year / All Time`, months along the x-axis, and a legend of `Applied` / `Interview` / `Offer` / `Rejected`.
- **A jobs table** below with columns: Title, Posted By, Posted On, Expires On, Sponsored Status, Applicants, Actions.

**A defect on the live demo you must NOT reproduce:** its table header is misspelled **"SPONORED STATUS"**. Yours must read "Sponsored Status". One of your tests checks this.

The live demo's entity is a near-empty UAT account showing zeros everywhere. **Do not copy that** — use non-zero values so the demo looks alive.

## Which member company is this?

Use **Highland Textile Works** — a `verified` member, based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It is the natural choice because it already has two jobs elsewhere on the site.

## Cross-page consistency is the thing most likely to go wrong

The previous task's review caught the seeker feed advertising jobs from suspended and un-joined employers. Do not create the equivalent problem here. Specifically:

- `pan-african-org/en/jobs-applications.html` lists Highland Textile Works' jobs: **Textile Production Supervisor** (2 applicants, flagged Hard-to-fill) and **Industrial Electrician** (18 applicants), both `Active`, both posted from Addis Ababa. Your table must agree with those titles and applicant counts for those rows.
- `pan-african-org/en/seeker-home.html` shows both of those jobs open, with "CLOSES IN 8 Days" and "CLOSES IN 5 Days" respectively. Your `Expires On` dates must be compatible with that.
- Your **tab counts must be internally consistent**: Active + Draft + Closed + Expired + Trash should equal All, and Active must equal the number of active rows you actually render and the `ACTIVE JOBS` KPI.
- Your **KPI numbers must be consistent with the table** — if you claim applicants awaiting review, the applicant counts in the table should make that plausible.
- Read those two pages before you start and take your figures from them.

Any new proper noun (a recruiter's name, say) goes in `pan-african-org/i18n/do-not-translate.json`.

## Design system and layout

Copy the `<head>` block — fonts, Phosphor icons, CSS custom properties — verbatim from `pan-african-org/en/index.html`. Then write the shell CSS for this layout.

**Charts are styled `div`s** — that is the established convention across this codebase (see the bar rows in `index.html` and `skill-gap.html`). No charting library, no canvas, no SVG chart library.

## Where the language toggle goes

This shell puts the toggle in the **top bar**, matching `seeker-home.html` rather than the sidebar footer used by the 11 admin pages. It must keep the exact `lang-toggle` container class and the `.lang-opt` / `hreflang` anchor markup shape, because `tools/build-i18n.js` finds the block by that class and rewrites the hrefs — if the shape is wrong, the French and Spanish builds in a later task silently fail to rewrite the links. Copy the block's structure from `seeker-home.html` and set the hrefs to `recruiter-jobs.html`, `../fr/recruiter-jobs.html`, `../es/recruiter-jobs.html`.

## Critical constraints

- **The ministry site is frozen.** No tracked file at repo root, `/fr`, `/es`, or `tutorial-video{,-fr,-es}/` may change.
- The page must open with `<!DOCTYPE html>` on line 1.
- No visible raw i18n keys (the live demo leaks `MYCAREER.RECENTCONVERSATIONS`-style strings on another page; do not introduce that class of bug).
- The page is embedded in a video composition later, so it must lay out cleanly at 1920×1080 with no horizontal overflow.

Note: `tutorial-video/snapshots/` is pre-existing untracked scratch — ignore it.

## Method

Append the brief's test cases to `tests/org-content.test.js` and run them first — they fail with `ENOENT` until the page exists. Build until they pass, then run `npm test` once before committing.

Then check it yourself: if you can run Playwright, load the page at 1920×1080, screenshot it, and confirm the KPI row, both chart panels and the table lay out sensibly with nothing overflowing.

## Report

Write your full report to:
`/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-20-pan-african-org-site-and-video/task-7-report.md`

Include TDD evidence (RED with output and why expected; GREEN), the figures you chose with the arithmetic showing tabs/KPIs/table agree, how your rows line up with `jobs-applications.html` and `seeker-home.html`, any new proper nouns added to the DNT list, and the freeze proof.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status, commits (short SHA + subject), a one-line test summary, any concerns, and the report file path.
